scope: Source GLB indexed object IDs, not census of physical detached buildings

rules.parts: Exclude building:part truthy except no/false/0; explicit part=no retained
rules.members: Exclude child when it is an explicit relation member and the parent ID is also indexed; no spatial merge of touching terrace houses
rules.aliases: Exclude explicitly listed source_part_ids when represented under another indexed asset; no name-based deduplication
rules.primary_count_warning: Mechanical classification, not independent buildings: yes/terrace/campus/relation may aggregate multiple houses and untagged appurtenances remain; excluded garages may themselves be physical standalone buildings
rules.overlap: Report area>1e-5m2 rather than automatically merging; vertical parts, imperfect mapping and shared-site relations need interpretation
